text:
{
  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system interprets past purchases as broad category interests more reliably than as evidence of specific current purposes or tastes.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations align when they add a concrete capability to an existing activity, such as complementary fastening supplies or useful equipment accessories.",
    "Entertainment recommendations align when they preserve specific listening qualities, including vocal arrangements, melodic warmth, intensity or atmosphere."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "Broadly related items compete with closer matches despite requiring equipment, projects or interests that interaction histories do not establish.",
    "Recommendations repeat functions users already own and suggest older alternatives without a clear additional benefit.",
    "Entertainment recommendations cross meaningful boundaries in sound, intensity, tone or subject despite sharing a broad category."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Shared category, brand or product vocabulary appears to substitute for shared purpose and compatibility.",
    "Recurring familiar products and albums suggest excessive reliance on general appeal relative to individual intent."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Recent and repeated interactions should distinguish sustained interests from isolated purchases and older needs.",
    "Practical relevance depends on compatibility, project scale and what an item adds to existing possessions.",
    "Entertainment choices depend on specific experiential qualities rather than broad genre membership.",
    "Sparse or unidentified histories provide weak support for confident preference generalization."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "Top recommendations often share a broad association with past behavior but lack the specific functional benefit or experiential fit that would motivate a choice now.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "Track the proportion of top recommendations users accept for a concrete purpose or specific taste connection.",
    "Track rejection reasons involving redundant functions, incompatible requirements or unsupported equipment and project assumptions.",
    "Track how often broadly related items outrank alternatives matching recent repeated interests and specific desired qualities.",
    "Separate judgments based on identifiable content from cases where insufficient item information prevents assessment."
  ]
}
